cond_0001.intro: In the Business Intelligence (BI) Developer II position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll foster a culture of self-service analytics and ensure the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights you generate will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.
Format and present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 Years of experience in Microsoft Power BI, including a minimum of 2 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server applications.
Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).

Experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.

cond_0120.intro:

In the Business Intelligence (BI) Developer II position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of self-service analytics and ensuring the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights generated by you will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization.
cond_0120.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.

Working knowledge of relational databases.
Familiarity with writing commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).
Some experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Exposure to AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.
Background in AWS.

cond_0170.intro:
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Developer II to join our team.
In this role, you'll bring your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to drive data-informed decisions across the organization. You'll take ownership of fostering a culture of self-service analytics and ensuring BI tools are used effectively. You'll also lead initiatives to advance our BI ecosystem, staying current on Power BI developments and executing process improvements. The reports and insights you deliver will directly shape operational efficiencies and strategic decisions across the organization.
cond_0170.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed to independently author reports in Power BI.
Lead ongoing mentorship of analysts, providing direction and feedback on report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take ownership of creating key reports that deliver critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay current on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to advance the efficiency of our BI ecosystem.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures to ensure scalability and reliability.
Build and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution delivery.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks to ensure timely product delivery.
Execute comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Handle customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Manage logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and execute Business Intelligence projects.
Proactively identify and resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, directing team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach clearly to customers.
Present reporting solutions and findings to customers, delivering necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and lead coordination with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0170.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field.

Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write T-SQL commands to extract data from relational databases (e.g., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).

Experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Experience utilizing AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.

In this position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll foster a culture of self-service analytics and ensure the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights generated by you will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization.
cond_0191.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.

Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.

Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Strong command of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).

cond_0272.intro:
We are looking for a Business Intelligence Developer II to join our team.
In this position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll foster a culture of self-service analytics and ensure the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights generated by you will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization.
cond_0272.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.
Format and present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including at least 2 years of proven, hands-on expertise in Microsoft SQL Server applications.
Advanced expertise in relational databases, with a strong command of database architecture and query optimization.
Advanced ability to write commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Proficiency in utilizing AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.
Expertise in AWS.

In this position, you'll use your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to support data-driven decisions across the organization. You'll help build a culture of self-service analytics and ensure effective use of our BI tools. You'll also lead efforts to evolve our BI ecosystem, keeping up with the latest Power BI developments and driving process improvements. The reports and insights you produce will directly support both operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.
cond_0334.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.
Format and present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0334.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 Years of experience in Microsoft Power BI. Of the 3-5 years of database reporting experience, a minimum of 2 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server applications.
Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).
Experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Experience utilizing AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.

cond_0365.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
In the Business Intelligence (BI) Developer II position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll foster a culture of self-service analytics and ensure the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights generated by you will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with BI development and data analysis work.
cond_0365.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.
Format and present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0365.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 Years of experience in Microsoft Power BI, including a minimum of 2 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server applications.
Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).
Preferred Requirements
Experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Experience utilizing AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.
AWS.

cond_0480.intro:
We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
In the Business Intelligence (BI) Developer II position, you'll utilize your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to empower data driven decisions across the organization. You'll play a pivotal role in fostering a culture of self-service analytics and ensuring the effective utilization of our BI tools. Additionally, you'll lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, staying abreast of the latest developments in Power BI and driving process improvements. The reports and insights generated by you will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making within the organization.
cond_0480.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs to equip analysts with the skills needed for independent report authoring in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, offering guidance and feedback in report creation and data visualization techniques.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, driving initiatives to enhance our BI ecosystem's efficiency.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Assess customer needs and validate requirements to ensure effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, ensuring timely product delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and communicate approach to customers.
Format and present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas for problem-solving.
cond_0480.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft Power BI, including ideally 2 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server applications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of relational databases.
Familiarity with writing commands in T-SQL to extract data from relational databases (i.e., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins, etc.).
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (i.e., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros, etc.).
Some experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to obtain a desired result.
Exposure to AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.
Background in AWS.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Developer II to join our team.
In this role, you'll use your expertise in data analysis and Power BI to support data-driven decisions across the organization. A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with analysts and stakeholders, fostering a culture of self-service analytics, and ensuring BI tools are used effectively. You'll also lead initiatives to evolve our BI ecosystem, keeping up with the latest Power BI developments and driving process improvements. The reports and insights you produce will directly contribute to both operational efficiencies and strategic decision-making.
cond_0510.responsibilities:
Develop and deliver training programs so analysts can independently author reports in Power BI.
Provide ongoing mentorship and support to analysts, giving guidance and feedback on report creation and data visualization.
Take a proactive role in creating key reports that provide critical insights for organizational decision-making.
Stay updated on the latest developments in Power BI and other BI tools, and actively drive initiatives to improve our BI ecosystem.
Monitor BI system health and performance, implementing measures for scalability and reliability.
Create and maintain large-scale BI solutions using Microsoft SQL Server, Power BI, and internal tools.
Connect with customers regularly to assess their needs and clarify requirements, ensuring effective solution derivation.
Manage customer expectations and prioritize tasks, communicating progress and ensuring timely delivery.
Perform comprehensive data analysis to address strategic business questions.
Optimize business logic through complex T-SQL query authoring.
Support customer business intelligence requests and implement system enhancements.
Assist in managing logical data layers following industry best practices.
Plan, design, and implement Business Intelligence projects.
Monitor and proactively resolve technical issues, providing second-tier support.
Review BI team development for accuracy and performance, supporting team members as needed.
Align technical BI development with business objectives and walk customers through the approach.
Present reporting solutions and findings to customers, providing necessary training and documentation.
Provide support for ad-hoc BI solutions and collaborate with other IT functional areas to solve problems.
cond_0510.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Systems, MIS, Database, Engineering, or a related field.
3–5 Years of experience in Microsoft Power BI, including a minimum of 2 years in Microsoft SQL Server applications.
Advanced proficiency in utilizing relational databases.
Advanced ability to write T-SQL commands to extract data from relational databases (e.g., stored procedures, views, functions, derived tables, complex joins).
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., formulas, formatting, pivot tables, macros).
Preferred Requirements
Experience coordinating projects, understanding requirements, creating milestones, and managing resources to achieve a desired result.
Experience using AI tools for productivity and efficiency gains.
AWS experience.
